invariants.rationale: The first statement in the method explicitly sets isRunning to true, so it must be true at method exit.
If resetOnStart is true, the effect is reset and then started, so it should not be complete at exit.
particleEffect is dereferenced unconditionally in the method, so it cannot be null at method exit.
Regardless of the previous state, calling start() on particleEffect typically ensures it is not complete.
